Package com.neueda.leap.order.submission.repository

Record Class AccountTradingProfile

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.neueda.leap.order.submission.repository.AccountTradingProfile
Record Components:
accountStatus - account lifecycle status
tradingEnabled - whether trading is enabled for the account
traderLevel - assigned trader tier
minimumBalanceRequirement - minimum cash balance required for the trader tier
currentBalance - current USD cash balance
public record AccountTradingProfile(String accountStatus, boolean tradingEnabled, String traderLevel, BigDecimal minimumBalanceRequirement, BigDecimal currentBalance) extends Record
Account fields needed by NEXT-99 before a new order is accepted.
